text: This is not true of any of the restaurants I go, guess it's a local thing. Here, the generally accepted price is 4x what it would cost in the store, whether that's 40 per bottle or 1000 per bottle. Further, because the stores that sell wine here are specialized, we are accustomed to experts advising us on our purchase, and lastly no one here would order wine because they could share a bottle... Those who order wine want wine, and almost all of us have one or more apps to look up, save and compare wines including store prices. Lastly, the alcohol taxes here are so steep, you already know you're getting ripped off and so does the waiter, so they are your ally in the quest to enjoy your time and nothing else, seeing as they don't live off of commission nor tips. Yes, I live in Norway
